title: Prometheus 3.0.0 OOMing when query logging is enabled
body:
### What did you do?

Initially, I thought this was an issue on my end, because I mistakenly upgraded from Prometheus v2.54.1 to Prometheus 3.0.0 (skipping Prometheus 2.55.0, [which was called out in the migration guide](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/3.0/migration/#tsdb-format-and-downgrade)).

Going off of that thought, I decided to do the following:
- Delete my existing TSDB (dev env, don't care)
- Uninstall Prometheus v3.0.0
- Install Prometheus v2.54.1
- Update to Prometheus v2.55.1
- Update to Prometheus v3.0.0

Unfortunately, the behavior persisted, so it can't have been the breaking TSDB change.

After all of that, I started running `pprof` against the heap, and found that `slog` was using a large amount of memory.

As you can see, `slog` is using a significant amount of memory comparatively. Both of these Prometheus instances are exactly the same, except for the version. Same scrape targets, same scrape jobs, same recording and alerting rules being evaluated.

### What did you expect to see?

_No response_

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

After the WAL replayed, I had roughly 10 to 15 minutes before the prometheus process would be oom killed. Additionally, I noticed that `/var/lib/prometheus/prometheus_query.log` was growing at exponential rates (1GB per 2s - using `watch`). The highest I saw it was 1.1TB, which is obviously quite concerning. When testing earlier in the week when I skipped v2.55.1, I noticed the same behavior. 

### System information

Linux 5.10.0-33-amd64 x86_64


### Prometheus configuration file


Relevant CNCF Slack thread with @tjhop: https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C167KFM6C/p1732131830045239

So you don't have to sift through Slack, here's TJ's theory:
>ok, I think I see what's happening. we set the query logger here:
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/cmd/prometheus/main.go#L894-L898
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/promql/engine.go#L454-L474
we're passing in JSONFileLogger as the query logger which does satisfy the querylogger interface, but the important bit is in the implementation of .With, in that it modifies it's internal logger in place and keeps appending over and over
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/promql/engine.go#L126-L135
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/util/logging/file.go#L56-L58
